content: tbc-audit.com (direct ParseForge competitor): free tier = paste-a-log enchant/gem/spec audit, no account. Pro tier EUR3.99/mo = full raid history grouped by phase, vertical cast log w/ timings, trend charts (weave/clip/uptime across nights), Top-100 comparison overlay. Guild tier EUR8.99/mo = full-roster boss-by-boss scorecards, gear/enchant/gem/consumable board, attendance tracking w/ alts, improvement trends. Also has a Leaderboards page.
